newsitem.title: USA: Lowe's Cos sees $1.2 bln 1997 capital budget.
newsitem.headline: Lowe's Cos sees $1.2 bln 1997 capital budget.

text.p: Lowe's Cos Inc said Monday its 1997 capital budget would be about $1.2 billion compared with 1996 capital investments of $994 million.
The company said its 1997 capital budget will include about $300 million in operating and capital leases. Over 80 percent of the investment is for store expansion, Lowe's said.
Lowe's said it ended fiscal year 1996 with 402 stores and 30.4 million square feet of retail selling space, representing a 27 percent increase over the previous year.
